ex.note: Choose any variation available or free at the gym

Blood flow restriction wraps to be used. Tightness level 8/10.

Pick a weight you can do 30 reps at.

Rest for only 20 secs between each set.

Don’t keep the wraps on for long. Unwrap them when done.

You will use the leg press machine for your calf presses.

See video in your exercise library.

Start at body weight first.

Once you exceed 15 reps, add one dumbbell to the leg pressing on the ground.
 
Once DBs become too big or uncomfortable, place a mat or towel underneath it.

Remember, wrist and elbows should be parallel throughout the whole movement.

Think of bringing your shoulder to touch your ears.

Elbows to waist.

Upper body leaning ~45d forward

Slow down as you straighten your arm.
Milk the eccentric.

Remember, wrist and elbows should be parallel throughout the whole movement.

Think of bringing your biceps to touch your chest without noticeable shoulder movement.

Chest proud at all times.

Face away from the machine. 

Stabilize the elbows. There should be minimum movement about the joint.

Rest the handles on your wrist bone for +stability 

Milk the eccentric (on the way down) phase.

Minor sideways and forward movements about the elbow is acceptable.

Focus on resisting and lowering  the weight with your triceps. 

Adjust your position accordingly until you get the best angle.

Make sure to watch the hip hinge tutorial
In your exercise library.

Blood flow restriction wraps to be used. Tightness level 8/10.

Pick a weight you can do 30 reps at.

Rest for only 20 secs between each set.

Don’t keep the wraps on for long. Unwrap them when done.

You will use the leg press machine for your calf presses.

See video in your exercise library.

Do it bilaterally-using both hands- as shown in the video in your exercise library.

Place two rope handles in the same side to pull one with each hand.

Milk the eccentric (straightening your arm).
Do it sitting on and back supported by a bench. Just like with the cable chest press on Upper 1

Shoulder in line with the cable.

Wear cuffs for added stability.

Milk the eccentric (lowering of the weight) phase.
